candidates.title: GORGO: Online Tuning for Cross-Region Network-Aware LLM Serving
candidates.reason: Cross-region LLM proxy jointly models network latency, prefill cost, queueing delay, and KV locality; held-out evaluation improves p95 TTFT by 6.9-15.5% and p95 E2E latency by 14.3-30.9%.

candidates.title: DualMap: Enabling Both Cache Affinity and Load Balancing for Distributed LLM Serving
candidates.reason: Directly addresses the cache-affinity versus load-balancing conflict in distributed LLM serving with SLO-aware dual mapping and hotspot rebalancing; reports up to 2.25x effective request capacity.

candidates.title: You Need an Encoder for Native Position-Independent Caching
candidates.reason: Introduces native position-independent KV caching plus the COMB serving system; reports 51-94% TTFT reduction and 3x throughput with comparable accuracy.

candidates.title: From Prefix Cache to Fusion RAG Cache: Accelerating LLM Inference in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
candidates.reason: Combines precomputed RAG KV caches with selective recomputation to recover cross-chunk context; reports 2.66-9.39x TTFT reduction versus full attention while improving normalized F1 at low recomputation ratios.

candidates.title: Nova: Real-Time Agentic Vision-Language Model Serving With Adaptive Cross-Stage Parallelization
candidates.reason: Agentic VLM serving system that pipelines vision encode, LLM prefill, and decode with elastic GPU partitioning and lightweight encoder-weight offload; reports up to 23.3% lower maximum latency.
